channel.title: Rip-Off Britain
channel.desc: Gloria Hunniford takes on the case of people awarded a judgement in court against a company that owes them money - but who are still out of pocket. Also on the programme, the team investigate why your mobile signal might not be as strong as your network provider claims. And regulator Ofgem finally steps in as the smart meter rollout continues to cause problems for customers.
